title: TAI bootstrap preflight actionless authority
objective: Break the circular TAI release dependency without weakening the hardened REG.RU runner: accept only the exact safe standalone-runtime materialization blockers as bootstrap-eligible, execute the owner self-hosted preflight without third-party GitHub Actions, transfer only bounded canonical redacted JSON to the hosted publisher, and retain strict zero-blocker post-deployment authority.
boundaries: Bootstrap eligibility requires exactly TAI_SERVICE_NOT_MATERIALIZED, TAI_DEDICATED_ENV_NOT_MATERIALIZED and TAI_DEDICATED_DB_PRINCIPAL_NOT_ATTESTED
All critical compose, exact-runtime, capacity, model-connectivity, TAI schema/profile and no-mutation checks must be PASS
The production self-hosted owner preflight job contains no third-party GitHub Action
The pcactions runner remains non-root and without direct Docker authority
Only the restricted root controller may inspect production and no production mutation is allowed during preflight
Preflight evidence is bounded to 65536 bytes, canonical JSON, schema-checked and exact-target-bound before transfer
Evidence is materialized and revalidated only on the hosted status publisher
Any additional, missing-authority, malformed or mutation-related blocker fails closed
Model admission remains a separately reported maturity state and is never fabricated
The owner command, exact-current-main image, immutable digest, non-root image user and protected REG.RU controller remain mandatory
Standalone deployment must still finish with a strict zero-blocker postflight
